gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-display: Dark and spiky, Eater spaces its thin strokes and weighty stems widely while Noto Sans Display stands tall below. Menace up top, then a thoroughly approachable body underneath it all.
gen-eater-gf-play: Wide gaps between thin strokes and moderately weighty stems give Eater a dark, aggressive look, with short ascenders. Play steps in as sans-serif text, tidy and level, to steady it.
gen-eater-gf-port-lligat-sans: Spiky, widely spaced menace is what Eater brings. Port Lligat Sans, modern and sans-serif, leaves its bowls unfinished on one side and packs its letters tight as pins in a cushion.
gen-eater-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Sharp and brooding, Eater spaces its thin strokes and weighty stems wide apart across the line. Saira Semi Condensed is plain sans type that looks magnified, its weight unvarying from word to word.
gen-eater-gf-secular-one: Dark mischief with wide gaps, that is Eater up top. Secular One, sans-serif with a dominant midsection, has zero modulation anywhere in the line while Eater's strokes keep a restrained rhythm.
gen-flavors-fs-plein: Flavors stands tall, whimsical and commanding, with a towering x-height. Plein, a reliable sans with a far more moderate lowercase height, gives each round letter a clear channel to enter.
gen-flavors-fs-spline-sans: Flavors towers with a pencil-stub x-height, and its diagonals carry as much heft as its stems. Spline Sans stays modest beside it, a contemporary sans with wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-flavors-fs-synonym: A towering x-height like a stubby carpenter's pencil gives Flavors its whimsical, commanding look, diagonals as hefty as stems. Synonym, a dependable sans, offers open curves in constant ink.
gen-flavors-gf-asimovian: Asimovian reads as plain sans, approachable and neutral, built from one stroke width with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. Flavors adds the whimsy up top, and paragraphs below should feel easygoing.
gen-flavors-gf-basic: Whimsical swagger with a towering x-height, that is Flavors. Basic is clean, modest sans with only a gentle bump up to capitals, leaving Flavors' stem-thick bowls to do the shouting.
